basketball.refit_rule: At each outer game refit coefficients/preprocessing on strictly earlier games; write/hash predictions before joining labels; admit labels only into next training history; no feature/model/hyperparameter redesign; inspect scores only after all five predictions saved
basketball.target: make conditional on all recorded field-goal releases, including fouled misses
basketball.quality_caveat: representation/frame agreement, not physical accuracy; directly detected sensitivity; no outcome-based threshold tuning
primary_feature_blocks: nearest defender distance and limited interaction
basketball.calibration: No separate fitted recalibrator in this ten-game study; held-out coarse reliability diagnostic only, no calibrated-model claim
basketball.expected_points_label: immediate field-goal points only: (2 or 3)*P(make), excludes foul rewards/rebounds/turnovers/continuation
basketball.claims_limit: exploratory five-game forward evaluation; no reliable modern NBA or league-wide superiority claim

frozen_candidates.zone: three x [0,6),[6,14),[14,22),[22,infinity) ft; shrinkage concentration 20 around training global rate
frozen_candidates.geometry: L2 logistic C=1, intercept, log1p(distance), three, absolute hoop-relative court bearing, shotClock and shotClock-missing indicator
frozen_candidates.defense: same plus log1p(closestDefDist) and its interaction with three

basketball.preprocessing: At each outer game fit median clock imputation and feature standardization on strictly earlier eligible rows only; fixed transformations/cutpoints; no class balancing
basketball.court_bearing_definition: abs(atan2(event_y, event_x + 40.75)) radians; hoop-to-shooter vector in offense-normalized event coordinates; valid behind-hoop observations retained

soccer_pose.target: provider-estimated pose measurement demonstration, not causal scoring model; independently validated contact alignment required before any mechanics/outcome fit
